notes.title: BattleCap Major Update: Performance Optimization & CPU Players
notes.content:
Dear Captains,

Thank you for your continued support and passion for BattleCap! We are always committed to delivering a smoother and richer gaming experience while steadily progressing on multi-platform porting. Today, we are thrilled to bring you a major version update, focusing on performance optimization and introducing thoughtful features like CPU players!

[h1]✨ Key Update Highlights ✨[/h1]
We understand that every player's experience matters, especially for captains using different hardware setups. This update aims to ensure more players can enjoy the game without performance concerns.

🚀 Performance Optimization
Reduced CPU usage significantly, allowing smoother gameplay even on lower-end systems.

Optimized rendering pipeline, fixing frame rate fluctuations in certain scenes for stable combat visuals.

Added full graphics settings, letting players fine-tune performance to reduce hardware strain.

🤖 Introducing CPU Players
Now, you can engage in intense PvP battles with AI opponents! When human players are scarce, AI will seamlessly fill the battlefield to keep the action going.


🚀 Update now and dive back into battle for a smoother, more thrilling experience!

If you encounter any issues after updating, feel free to reach out via our official community or support team. We’ll keep refining the game based on your feedback. Once again, thank you for your support—more exciting content is on the way!

— The BattleCap Development Team
